---
title: "phit-polyfill"
---

phit-polyfill is a pure-PHP implementation of the
[phit](https://github.com/phpstats/phit) extension's functions, except the
CSV reader (`Phit\read_csv` and `Phit\CsvReader`), which needs the
extension. When the extension is not loaded, the polyfill defines them in the
`Phit` namespace with the extension's names, parameter names, defaults, result keys, warnings, and
exception codes. Code written against phit runs on hosts where the extension
cannot be installed, such as shared hosting or a managed platform without
custom extensions. When the extension is loaded, the polyfill defines nothing.

The implementations follow phit's Rust code operation for operation. The
parity tests compare their results bit for bit with the extension.
[Compatibility and limitations](php-versions.qmd) describes the JIT
restrictions and architecture differences. In the benchmarks, the
recorded regression fits take 9 to 23 times as long, and mixed models 13 to 78
times as long (see [Compatibility and limitations](php-versions.qmd)).

## Installation

```bash
composer require phpstats/phit-polyfill
```

The polyfill supports PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5 (`composer.json` requires
`>=8.3 <8.6`). CI tests all three. No PHP extension is required.

Composer's autoloader loads the polyfill's `bootstrap.php`. If any version
of the `phit` extension is loaded, the bootstrap defines nothing. Otherwise it
declares each function the polyfill implements, unless a function of that name already exists.

The polyfill's functions throw an exception with code 1007 while OPcache's JIT
compiles the process. Set `opcache.jit=disable` where the polyfill runs.

## Usage

Import functions with `use function`, or call them by their qualified names.

This script runs in a new Composer project after
`composer require phpstats/phit-polyfill`. Save it as `fit.php` there and run
`php fit.php`. It reads mtcars from the
[PHPstats datasets repository](https://github.com/phpstats/datasets) and
prints the fit with `summary()`.

```php
<?php

require __DIR__.'/vendor/autoload.php';

use function Phit\{fit_ols, summary};

// mtcars from the PHPstats datasets repository, read into columns.
$url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstats/datasets/main/csv/'
    .'mtcars.csv';
$rows = array_map(
    fn (string $line) => str_getcsv($line, escape: ''),
    file($url, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES),
);
$cars = [];
foreach (array_shift($rows) as $j => $name) {
    $cars[$name] = array_map(
        fn (string $v) => is_numeric($v) ? (float) $v : $v,
        array_column($rows, $j),
    );
}

$fit = fit_ols('mpg ~ wt + factor(cyl)', $cars);
echo summary($fit);
```

```text
Linear model fit by least squares
Formula: mpg ~ wt + factor(cyl)

Coefficients:
             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)
(Intercept)   33.9908     1.8878  18.006  < 2e-16
wt            -3.2056     0.7539  -4.252 0.000213
factor(cyl)6  -4.2556     1.3861  -3.070 0.004718
factor(cyl)8  -6.0709     1.6523  -3.674 0.000999

Residual standard error: 2.557 on 28 degrees of freedom
Multiple R-squared: 0.8374, Adjusted R-squared: 0.82
F-statistic: 48.08 on 3 and 28 DF, p-value: 3.594e-11
```

The same code runs with the extension loaded. Without the extension,
`Phit\read_csv` is undefined, so the script reads the CSV file itself.

## Availability {#checking-what-is-available}

`Phit\Polyfill\Polyfill` reports which functions the polyfill implements and
whether the extension is loaded.

```php
use Phit\Polyfill\Polyfill;

Polyfill::supports('Phit\fit_generalized_linear'); // true
Polyfill::supports('Phit\read_csv');               // false: extension only
Polyfill::nativeLoaded();                          // whether phit is loaded
```

`Polyfill::implementation('Phit\fit_ols')` returns the polyfill's callable
even when the extension is loaded, and it skips the JIT check. The parity
tests and the benchmarks use it to run both implementations in one process.

## Versions

Each polyfill release reproduces the phit commit pinned in
`tests/fixtures/REFERENCE`. phit v0.3.1 changes only packaging and
documentation, so it has the same functions as v0.3.0. phit v0.4.1 and
v0.4.2 change only the CSV reader, which the polyfill leaves to the extension. phit v0.6.1 has no polyfill release; polyfill 0.6.2
reproduces v0.6.2, which fixes a hang in v0.6.1.

| Polyfill | phit |
|---|---|
| 0.6.2 | v0.6.2 (`d8caf83`) |
| 0.6.0 | v0.6.0 (`00c0297`) |
| 0.5.1 | v0.5.1 (`c60fb9b`) |
| 0.5.0 | v0.5.0 (`17729a8`) |
| 0.4.2 | v0.4.4 (`066e2e1`) |
| 0.4.1 | v0.4.3 (`db75800`) |
| 0.4.0 | v0.4.0 (`076f019`) |
| 0.3.1 | v0.3.0 (`2629fe1`) and v0.3.1 (`96e29e1`) |
| 0.3.0 | v0.3.0 (`2629fe1`) |
| 0.2.0 | v0.2.0 (`ac176ff`) |
| 0.1.0 | v0.1.1 (`f4887a4`) |
